install.title: Tombo
install.lead: A modern print interface for the lab printer. Drop files, adjust settings, and print — while keeping the printer's built-in interface available anytime.
install.step1: Drag the button below onto your browser's bookmarks bar.
install.step1Hint: Bookmarks bar hidden? Press Ctrl+Shift+B (⌘+Shift+B on Mac) in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox. In Safari, choose View → Show Favorites Bar.
install.buttonNote: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar — clicking it here won't do anything.
install.use1: Open the printer's web page as usual (using the lab printer address).
install.use2: Click Tombo in your bookmarks bar to launch the new interface.
faq: Reloading brought back the old interface.
Refreshing always loads the printer's built-in screen. Just click Tombo in your bookmarks bar again.
Nothing happens when I click the bookmark.
Make sure you're on the printer's web page first. On other sites, clicking it simply shows a reminder.
I can't drag the button to my bookmarks bar.
Copy the code below, create a new bookmark manually, paste it into the URL field, and name it Tombo.
How do I switch back to the original interface?
Click “Switch to classic UI” at the bottom of the page, or simply reload.
Are my files sent to an external server?
No. Files and settings go directly from your browser to the printer, and your preferences stay local to this browser.
